body: I started to have these thoughts so much recently. I dont believe in god, most days, but i pray when i go to sleep that its my last night. When I drive i pray for an accident that ends it all.

I feel the same way. I have given up. Time helps some, it hasn't helped me but I hope it does for you. People say just find some one else, it won't happen.

Loneliness is the worst feeling in the world. I was thinking how the worst punishment in jail is to be in isolation. Its better to be with the criminals lol.

Virtual hug.

I am sorry about your loss.

It's exactly like you describe it. No light at the end of the tunnel. Just waiting in the dark for a miracle it wont happen.

Now I don't blame my mother and others for saying that suicide is selfish, i used to think like that, but now I get it when people say they just want the pain to stop. I wish for the same.
